description: Daily statistics (default: mean) for one or more USGS gauges. Use this for any query that crosses days or asks about historic dates. Pass either `period` (relative-to-now) OR `start_date`/`end_date` (historic range), not both. For real-time sub-hour resolution prefer `get_instantaneous_values`. Returns one daily value per (site × parameter × statistic × day). USGS quality codes: 'A' = approved, 'P' = provisional.

end_date.description: Historic range end (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when start_date is set.

items.description: USGS 5-digit parameter code. Common values: '00060' = streamflow / discharge in ft³/s; '00065' = gage height in feet; '00010' = water temperature in °C. Full list: https://help.waterdata.usgs.gov/codes-and-parameters/parameters

period.description: Relative window ending now. Examples: 'P7D', 'P30D', 'P1Y'. Mutually exclusive with start_date/end_date.

sites.description: Array of USGS site numbers. Single-site queries are typical.

items.description: USGS site number, 8 to 15 digits identifying a single gauging station. Examples: '12045500' (Elwha River at McDonald Bridge near Port Angeles, WA); '12048000' (Dungeness River near Sequim, WA). Use `search_sites` to discover site numbers for a region.

start_date.description: Historic range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Pair with end_date for an explicit window.

statistic_codes.description: USGS statistic codes, '00003' = mean (default), '00001' = max, '00002' = min, '00008' = median.

name: get_daily_values
title: Daily USGS Streamflow Statistics (Current or Historic)
